title: How many CFD runs the cheap model buys
description: The capsule-aeroheating corpus (1.024 panel-method runs, 64 laminar Navier-Stokes ones on the same wall) as a multi-fidelity learning curve: the cheap model, a surrogate from the design alone, a learned correction, and the correction with the cheap model as an input, at N = 4 to 64 expensive designs.

metrics.name: heat_load_cheap_model_error
metrics.how: the panel method's own value against the Navier-Stokes one, all 64 expensive designs, no fit

metrics.name: heat_load_difference_at_8
metrics.how: correction to the cheap model fitted on 8 expensive designs, scored on the 56 it did not see, median over 20 splits

metrics.name: heat_load_design_only_at_64
metrics.how: surrogate of the target from the six inputs alone, same split as the correction

metrics.name: heat_load_fidelity_gap
metrics.how: mean of the cheap model over mean of the expensive one, minus 1: the bias
